meta.name: cpp-pro
meta.description: Writes, optimizes, and debugs C++ applications using modern C++20/23 features, template metaprogramming, and high-performance systems techniques. Use when building or refactoring C++ code requiring concepts, ranges, coroutines, SIMD optimization, or careful memory management — or when addressing performance bottlenecks, concurrency issues, and build system configuration with CMake.

copy.tagline: 编写、优化和调试现代 C++ 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 C++20/23 开发高性能系统或重构遗留代码
copy.tagline_en: Write, optimize, and debug modern C++ applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building high-performance systems or refactoring legacy C++ code with modern standards

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会使用现代 C++20/23 特性（如概念、范围、协程）编写、优化和调试 C++ 代码，并遵循 C++ 核心指南，自动应用 RAII、智能指针等最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你要求编写、重构或优化 C++ 代码，涉及现代 C++ 特性、模板元编程、性能优化、并发或 CMake 构建时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 C++20 概念写一个数值类型安全的 clamp 函数。
say.note: Claude 会生成带概念约束的模板代码。

say.text: 优化这段 C++ 代码，使用 SIMD 指令加速。
say.note: Claude 会分析并应用 SIMD 优化。

howto.what_en: Claude writes, optimizes, and debugs C++ code using modern C++20/23 features, template metaprogramming, and high-performance techniques, following C++ Core Guidelines and applying RAII, smart pointers, and const-correctness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write, refactor, or optimize C++ code involving modern C++ features, template metaprogramming, performance, concurrency, or CMake build configuration.

say_en.text: Write a type-safe clamp function using C++20 concepts.
Optimize this C++ code with SIMD instructions.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and applies SIMD optimizations.

say_en.text: Add a CMakeLists.txt with all warnings and sanitizers enabled.
say_en.note: Claude generates a compliant build configuration.
